title: OEIS Learn CLI Command Contract
description: Interface specification for the oeis-learn command-line tools

ingest.description: Ingest and index OEIS database records from oeisdata and joeis into local DuckDB / SQLite storage.

--data-path.description: Path to local OEIS stripped/names data files

train.description: Train the Tri-Stream Encoder and Transformer policy using EGCA-GRPO curriculum learning.

--tier.description: Hardware tier (1 = local workstation baseline, 2 = cluster scale-up)

--num-cpu-threads.description: Number of Rayon CPU worker threads for WASM execution

synthesize.description: Synthesize a WebAssembly algorithm for a target sequence or arbitrary integer list.

--extrapolate.description: Number of future terms to evaluate for generalization

discover.description: Run the self-supervised manifold discovery and PSLQ theorem verification pipeline.

--checkpoint.description: Path to model checkpoint with VICReg embeddings

--max-candidates.description: Maximum number of vector relation candidates to verify

--precision-digits.description: Decimal precision digits for mpmath sampling

--output-proofs.description: Destination file for verified symbolic proofs
